items.title: AI-Assisted Application Development
items.description: I use AI-assisted coding tools such as Claude to turn concepts into working prototypes and suitable web applications, so you can test an idea with something real, then iterate on it based on feedback.
items.note: AI speeds up the build, but it does not replace testing, technical judgment or security review. For production systems handling sensitive data or scale, I will be upfront about when additional engineering support is needed.
